topic: Reading a GoMining digital miner: TH/s and W/TH
hook: Two numbers on a GoMining digital miner decide a lot. Do you know them?

scenes.narration: TH/s is the hashrate the digital miner represents in the data centre.
W/TH is its efficiency in watts per terahash. Lower is more efficient.
Digital miners are not redeemable for bitcoin, and owners do not hold the underlying hardware.
Details change, so check gomining.com for the current numbers.

cta: Which number do you look at first? Tell me below, and my referral link is in the description.
title: GoMining Digital Miners: TH/s and W/TH Explained
description_body: A digital miner represents a share of hashrate with an efficiency in W/TH. Check gomining.com for current details.
